lines.text: In the twelfth year, God tells Ezekiel to take up a lament for Pharaoh, who is like a lion among the nations.
God will spread His tent over Pharaoh, draw him up, and abandon him in an open field.
When God extinguishes Pharaoh, He will darken the stars, cover the sun with a cloud, and keep the moon's light away.
The sword of the king of Assyria will come against Pharaoh, and the most ruthless of all nations will destroy Egypt's hordes.
God will make Egypt a desolation so they know He is the LORD, and the daughters of the nations will chant the lament.
